Ploff third-party notices
=========================

JavascriptSubtitlesOctopus 4.1.0
---------------------------------
Copyright (c) 2017-2021 JavascriptSubtitlesOctopus contributors.
Licensed under the MIT License. See subtitles-octopus.LICENSE.txt.

The distributed renderer contains libass and its build dependencies,
including Brotli, Expat, FreeType, FriBidi, Fontconfig and HarfBuzz. Their
copyright notices and complete applicable license texts are preserved in
subtitles-octopus.COPYRIGHT.txt. This includes the LGPL-2.1+ terms applicable
to FriBidi.

Corresponding source and build provenance:

  Upstream repository:
  https://github.com/libass/JavascriptSubtitlesOctopus

  Upstream tag: 4.1.0
  Upstream commit: 0b0f95a38879caf132a5516a16e8b2e2cb0382e0

Clone the upstream source and every pinned native-library submodule with:

  git clone --recursive --branch 4.1.0 \
    https://github.com/libass/JavascriptSubtitlesOctopus.git

Ploff preserves the original generated legacy worker in compressed form at
scripts/vendor-sources/subtitles-octopus-worker-legacy-4.1.0.full.js.gz. The
complete, reproducible Ploff transformation is implemented by
scripts/slim-ass-legacy-worker.js and documented in
scripts/vendor-sources/README.md. These files are available in the Ploff
source repository for the same release.

The original WASM JavaScript glue is preserved at
scripts/vendor-sources/subtitles-octopus-worker-wasm-4.1.0.full.js.gz.
scripts/slim-ass-legacy-worker.js --wasm applies the same Ploff protocol to it.
The corresponding subtitles-octopus-worker.wasm binary is unmodified.

Liberation Sans fallback font
-----------------------------
The unmodified app/vendor/default.woff2 is the fallback font distributed by
JavascriptSubtitlesOctopus 4.1.0 as assets/default.woff2.

Upstream Git blob: a562391696ad477e5a8ad28ef8b4d53c90bb0d42
SHA-256: 886929903707c5bb28b07cd2eed69921b3d5ef5c49c73a0dd1e187ebf6546a4c

Liberation Sans is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Copyright
and the complete license are preserved in LICENSE.default-font.txt.

default.ttf is the decompressed sfnt representation of this same font,
generated by scripts/decompress-ass-font.py using fontTools and Brotli.
Glyphs, metrics and naming tables are preserved; the same license applies.
TTF SHA-256: 1907752f169eac97a38f11da1867d1a10d949658158ed010e56a3bba46b8e679

Other packaged components
-------------------------
The QR code generator license is in LICENSE.qrcode-generator.txt.
The webOS TV JavaScript library license is in webOSTV.LICENSE.txt.

Upstream repository:
